losses: Engineer is both an occupation and story role but current CharacterProfile has only one generic role field.
The AI system may be a character, system entity or antagonist; the current input contract cannot distinguish this.
The creator-system relationship has no typed representation.
The moral boundary and name lock are prose only and cannot be enforced.
Current production ontology seeds do not contain Sci-Fi, Mystery or AI nodes; this simulation requires fixture-only nodes.
potential_conflicts: Discovery is an emotional movement rather than a conventional emotion and should not automatically become an Emotion ontology node.
Hidden Truth is both the premise and a Twist; over-weighting it may force repetitive reveals.
